summary: Backend 8/8 + Rider-UI 100% PASS. Verified: (1) /rider→/rider/login redirect with all testids (rider-login-page/email/password/submit), rider1 login reaches /rider. (2) OrderDetail in Courses shows order-call, order-whatsapp, order-message-client (toggles rider-client-chat with OrderThread), and order-route; status-fail opens fail-form with fail-reason-0..4, fail-note, fail-photo, fail-postpone+fail-date, fail-confirm. (3) /rider/carte?route=<id> renders map-route-panel with map-route-stats ('42.5 km · ~46 min · activez la localisation'), map-route-google link, and map-route-close button; OSRM reachable from sandbox (no '(estimation)' fallback shown). (4) /livreur redirects to /rider (/rider/login when logged out) — slug 'livreur' is active. (5) Unknown /xyz-nope falls through SlugRedirect to /login (logged out) — intended behavior per code (SlugRedirect → /console → ProtectedConsole → /login). Backend pytest: public/rider-cms returns schema with tabs/colors; PATCH /api/rider-cms access_slug=livreur persists; /api/auth/me returns role=rider; GET+POST /api/orders/{oid}/thread/rider_customer OK for owning rider (POST sends 'TEST_hello cliente'); 403 for a different rider; admin can read it; /api/orders-messages/unread returns {count,by_order:{}} for rider; customer login (customer-login-code with phone/code 202601) lists threads via /api/public/account/threads.

issues: 'Pointer mon arrivée en me connectant' checkbox is pre-checked by default, which blocks 'Se connecter' until the user either takes an arrival photo or unchecks the box. This UX quirk also blocks automated E2E tests of console pages. Consider default-unchecked (opt-in) or allow submit without photo (and prompt only after login).

action_items: (design) Default-uncheck 'Pointer mon arrivée' on staff /login so automated tests and daily logins don't require a photo. Not blocking this iteration's scope.
No functional bugs found for this iteration — ImageEditor + console AccessCard UI were not browser-tested due to admin-login friction; backend access_slug persistence IS covered by the pytest suite.
critical_code_review_comments: ImageEditor: cssFilter uses hue-rotate for warmth which is not a true temperature shift; functional but perceptually different from a classic blue↔orange warmth. Low priority.
Carte.jsx fallback distance uses straight-line Haversine with /0.4 km/min speed → ~24 km/h; label says '(estimation)'. Good.

SlugRedirect: when a slug doesn't match, it <Navigate to='/console'> → ProtectedConsole bounces to /login when logged out. Intended but worth documenting; a direct 'not found' route might be clearer for public visitors hitting /any-random.
messagerie._order_for: rider access limited to party in {rider, rider_customer} AND o.rider_id == user.id — correct 403 for other riders (verified).
orders-messages/unread for rider includes rider_customer threads via regex ^order:.*\|rider(_customer)?$ and only counts messages from store/customer not read by user — correct.

LivreurApp.AccessCard: `url` is computed from ctx.cms.access_slug but defaults to 'rider' when empty — matches test expectation (ends with /livreur after save). Reserved words validated client-side only via RESERVED array (includes 'boutique').

success_rate.frontend: 100% of rider flows (login redirect, courses, fail-form, client-chat, route panel, slug redirect). ImageEditor + console AccessCard UI not browser-verified due to staff-login UX friction; access_slug covered by backend pytest.
